standard.title: Create and present informative and imaginative texts
standard.description: create and present informative and imaginative spoken, written and multimodal texts, using a range of sentence structures and modelled textual conventions, characters appropriate to context, and/or the target language writing system
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can create short spoken, written and multimodal texts using modelled phrases and sentences (AC9LCH2C05). They can produce written target language and perform created texts for a purpose and audience. They have not yet created extended texts using a range of sentence structures, produced informative texts for real audiences, or created imaginative texts such as alternative story endings or original performances.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students create and present a range of informative and imaginative spoken, written and multimodal texts using sentence structures and textual conventions appropriate to purpose and context.

nodes.label: Using a range of sentence structures
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can construct sentences using a range of structures — including descriptive, compound and complex sentences — appropriate to the text type being created.
nodes.minimum_width: Produce at least three sentences in the target language using different structures (e.g. a simple statement, a sentence with a modifier, and a question or compound sentence).
nodes.typical_width: Use a range of sentence structures in created texts — simple, compound, descriptive, and question forms; use familiar words, phrases and idioms to add variety and expression; apply appropriate writing system conventions (stroke order, direction, punctuation) to written texts.
wider: Analyse a model text and identify the sentence structures used — then deliberately vary the structures in an original text to achieve different effects
Experiment with how the same information reads differently depending on sentence structure choice — compare two versions of the same content and discuss the effect of each
nodes.hinge_reason: Sentence structure range is the prerequisite for creating extended, coherent texts. Students who can only produce simple or formulaic sentences cannot create the informative or imaginative texts with textual conventions that this descriptor requires.

response_modes.reason: Sentence structure range requires repeated production practice across different text types before it becomes flexible and reliable. Scaffolded writing tasks with explicit structure modelling — then progressive reduction of scaffolding — build this productive fluency.

success_criteria: Produces at least three sentences using at least two different sentence structures
Applies correct writing system conventions in at least one written text

nodes.label: Creating informative texts for a purpose and audience
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can create informative texts in spoken, written or multimodal form using appropriate textual conventions, with supporting visual elements where relevant.
nodes.minimum_width: Create at least one informative text (display, presentation, poster, or report) using at least five target language sentences with appropriate textual conventions.
nodes.typical_width: Create informative texts — visual displays, presentations, annotated posters, digital storyboards — about topics of personal or community interest; use supporting images, charts and graphs; convey information about school, community and cultural topics; create descriptions for real-world contexts.
wider: Create an informative text for a real external audience — for example, a travel brochure, a community newsletter, or a First Nations Country/Place description — with language and format selected for that audience
Compare the language features of two different informative text types — identify how audience and purpose shape vocabulary and structure choices

response_modes.reason: Informative text creation requires students to understand that different purposes and audiences call for different conventions. Varied creation tasks — presentation, poster, storyboard, digital text — build this contextual awareness before students can make independent text-type choices.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Background learners have authentic informative content to share — cultural knowledge, community events, family histories. Width investment in informative creation tasks that draw on this personal content produces genuinely communicative texts and positions students' knowledge as valuable.
success_criteria: Creates an informative text using at least five target language sentences with appropriate format conventions
Uses at least one supporting visual element (image, chart, or diagram) appropriately in the text

nodes.label: Creating imaginative texts and performances
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can create and perform imaginative texts — stories, songs, plays, dialogues — adapting familiar narratives or creating original work for a specific audience.
nodes.minimum_width: Create and perform at least one imaginative text (story, song, dialogue, or play) using at least six target language phrases, with a clear structure (beginning, middle, end or equivalent).
nodes.typical_width: Create and perform imaginative texts — alternative story endings, action songs, scripted dialogues, mini-plays — adapting familiar structures with new content; use descriptive language and expression; share creative work with teachers, peers and where possible wider audiences.
wider: Create an original imaginative text — not based on a familiar story — with a deliberate structural choice and at least one creative language decision (wordplay, descriptive phrase, or cultural reference)
Reflect on a peer's imaginative text and provide targeted feedback on at least two elements — structure, language choices, or audience impact

response_modes.reason: Imaginative text creation integrates sentence structure range (node 1) and informative text conventions (node 2) into a creative register where personal expression is foregrounded. The teaching investment is in creating genuine performance occasions and providing structural freedom within supported parameters.

success_criteria: Creates an imaginative text with a clear structure using at least six target language phrases
Performs the text demonstrating awareness of audience — through expression, pace or delivery choices
